A.baseline: bounded D-H inverse kinematics plus BFS
A.primary: multi-start bounded IK, Pareto energy, exact lattice shortest paths and subset DP
A.fatal_risk: D-H convention or energy proxy left implicit

B.primary: coordinate-feature wirelength regression plus constrained analytical placement
B.fatal_risk: calling a heuristic 444-dimensional placement globally optimal

selection_reason: A has complete official parameters, a small exact discrete routing layer, a falsifiable kinematic core, strong figures and the lowest external-data risk. It supports a full end-to-end paper without inventing transport data.
switch_condition: Switch to B only if two independently implemented standard D-H calculations cannot reconcile the target and zero-state geometry or no feasible Q1 solution within 200 mm is found after the approved fallback.
